# GET /api/v1/user/actions/variables

Get the user-level list of variables which is created by current doer

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-136`

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Variable name must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ and not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix, and not be 'CI' | validation | !namePattern.MatchString(name) || forbiddenPrefixPattern.MatchString(name) || strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Variable data must not exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes | validation | always applied on insert/update |
| Variable name is stored uppercase | business_logic | always on insert |
